title: Local pilot registry
summary: Adapts one to four active local seats to borrowed session identities and device preferences.

blocks.text: Adapts one to four active local seats to borrowed session identities and device preferences.

Provides input.local-pilots@1.0.0. Optional input.flight-profiles@1.0.0 supplies flight preference defaults/migration; the generic seat registry works without it. Constructors receive identity, assignment and release callbacks.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

Owns the existing local-player preference codec and migration, including independent names, device assignments and navball placements. Session credentials remain session-owned. This registry never grants network ownership. Device changes release held input first; disposal releases the registry.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.
